Title: Azure Log Analytics is now General Available in Australia East and in Australia Central

Body.Content:
Azure Log Analytics is part of Azure Monitor. It collects telemetry from a variety of sources and uses the query language from Azure Data Explorer to retrieve and analyze data.

Azure Log Analytics is now General Available in Australia East and in Australia Central.

Learn more about Azure Monitor and Log Analytics here.

See the availability by region here.
